sonnet.problem: The blank asks which instrument verse 5 names last. Nothing on the earlier cards lets the baker reason to 'cymbals' over 'bells' or 'zithers', so the card asks the baker to guess the wording of a line they haven't seen.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

sonnet.problem: The two wrong answers both start with 'Only', while the right answer starts with 'Everything' and copies the verse's wording. The right answer stands out from the other two.
sonnet.rule: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike.
